name: Text as a whole
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council establishing the Programme for agile and rapid defence innovation (AGILE)
part_text:
1. The European Parliament wants a new one-year fund, worth about 115 million euro in 2027, to help small and start-up defence companies turn new technology into products armies can use quickly. The money would back fast development, testing and buying of drones, software, sensors and space-based tools, with simpler paperwork and faster decisions. Parliament also wants Ukraine to benefit and to join without paying in.

2. Bullet points:
- A 115 million euro fund for 2027 supporting small and start-up defence firms.
- Faster, simpler awards; up to 100% of costs covered; Ukraine can join without paying.
- Parliament's position now goes to EU governments for negotiation on the final law.
